text:
inc-bot: 🔔 SEV2 ALERT: sustained p99 latency spike on /v1/stream (hosted). rolling 5m p99 = 2.9s (SLO 400ms). Streaming stall rate ~3.1%. Paging @Rajiv Singh

Rajiv Singh: I'm up. Quick question — global or region-specific? Any customer pages?

Nora Kim: looks global but highest in us-west-2. Grafana: config-service error rate increased x6; config-fetch p99 ~4.6s. Feature-flag DB (ff-db) has high I/O wait.

Diego Morales: auth-db p99 ~2.2s. Connection pool used at 98%. Slow queries show repeated token lookups for same token.

Rajiv Singh: ok. immediate mitigation candidates: 1) disable feature-flag checks for host pools (emergency toggle) 2) bump token cache TTL on edge 3) reduce batch wait to lower tail queuing 4) route config reads to replica. Priya, can you handle comms to affected customers while we triage?

Priya Shah: on it. Drafting note: "We're investigating increased latency and intermittent stream stalls for some sessions. Mitigations being applied now; will follow up in 15 min."

Nora Kim: I'm going to throttle outbound config-service retries and prefer read replicas for reads. Applying now.

Nora Kim: applied: `ENV CONFIG_PREFER_REPLICA=true` and `CONFIG_RETRY_POLICY=exp_backoff(max=150ms)`

deploy-bot: deploy started: config-service -> prefer-replica flag rollout 20% -> 100%

Nora Kim: replica routing rolled out. config-fetch p99 dropped to 780ms. ff-db cpu still high but less tripping.

Diego Morales: applied quick fix at the auth edge: increased token cache TTL from 5s -> 45s for hosted traffic and increased auth client connection pool from 50 -> 150 for 10m. Command: `PATCH /internal/config/token_cache_ttl 45s` and `PATCH /internal/config/auth_pool_size 150`

Rajiv Singh: good. I'm enabling an emergency local-routing-cache to short-circuit remote feature-flag lookups for routing decisions on the inference path. This will use last-known variant for 30s on misses.

Nora Kim: `POST /internal/flags/emergency_local_route_cache {"enabled":true,"ttl_s":30}` -> applied.

inc-bot: state update: emergency_local_route_cache = true; token_cache_ttl = 45s; auth_pool_size bumped. Severity: SEV2.

Priya Shah: sent customer note to impacted CSMs (CUST-788, CUST-901). CUST-788 reported session disconnects during live demos. They want an update in 30m.

Diego Morales: after TTL bump and pool increase, auth-db qps down ~28%, connection saturation resolved. p99 overall dropped to ~550ms. Streaming stalls reduced to 0.9%.

Rajiv Singh: nice. Still seeing a small tail for long streams (>60s). Traces show initial SSE flush delays caused by config-fetch sometimes taking 400-600ms before token lookup. Might be coupling on init path. We should add a timeout fallback so inference can start with the last known routing variant if control-plane doesn't respond within 120ms.

Nora Kim: agree. Implementing a 120ms timeout and immediate fallback to default variant in config-client. Pushing small binary patch to hosted-pool.

Nora Kim: patch rolled out to 30% now. `configClient.getVariant(timeout=120ms, fallback=DEFAULT)`

deploy-bot: rollout at 100% for config-client fast-fallback.

Rajiv Singh: excellent. After fast-fallback rollout, startup latency for streams improved; p99 now ~420ms. We should keep emergency toggles for now and prepare a post-incident plan.

Priya Shah: support-ops updated customers. Offering scheduled 1:1 for CUST-788. No billing actions required.

Diego Morales: note: ff-db shows overheated disk queue; infra will add IO capacity. Opened infra ticket INFRA-1298 to scale ff-db and add read replicas.

Rajiv Singh: handover and runbook: I'll prepare a brief for next oncall. Actions to include: 1) check config-fetch p99, ff-db CPU/IO, auth-db pool usage 2) confirm emergency flags (local_route_cache=true, token_cache_ttl=45s) 3) verify stream stall rate <1% 4) rollback steps for toggles in runbook if we observe regressions.

Priya Shah: runbook note: communicate any rollback before rolling back to customers.

inc-bot: on-call handover scheduled at 1934001800. Next on-call: Diego Morales.

Diego Morales: I'll take it. Current state summary: emergency_local_route_cache=true; token_cache_ttl=45s; auth_pool_size=150; config reads -> replica; config-client fast-fallback enabled. Watching p99 and stream_stall_ratio.

Rajiv Singh: post-incident follow-ups: 1) product ticket to add host-side routing cache and formal degraded-mode behavior for control-plane timeouts (INF-8120) 2) permanent config for token cache and auth pool sizing policy under load (INF-8121) 3) infra to scale ff-db and add additional replicas (INFRA-1298). I'll own the postmortem. Diego/SRE to collect traces and DB slow queries.

Priya Shah: customer comms scheduled. Next update in 30 minutes or on major changes. :mag:

inc-bot: incident channel created #inc-1934000001. Severity SEV2.

Diego Morales: adding observation: some clients retried aggressively on timeout which amplified ff-db load. Recommend client-side retry jitter and circuit-breaker for config fetch. Adding to INF-8120.

Rajiv Singh: thanks all. Good mitigation set. We'll close when p99 stable near baseline for 1h and infra confirms ff-db scale.

support-ops: noted. Closing checklist: customer-notes posted, runbook updated, postmortem owner assigned.

inc-bot: handover reminder -> 1934001800.
